text:
Anton Lundell has eight points in 18 games, which reads like a slow start for a two-time Stanley Cup winner playing 17 and a half minutes a night. The underlying numbers tell a different story. Florida has 56% of expected goals with him on the ice at 5v5, almost six points better than without him, and he leads this group in shots with 50.

The problem has been finishing, his and everyone else's. He is shooting 8% against a usual range around 12%, and the Panthers have scored 5.5 fewer goals than their chances deserved with him out there. That is the kind of gap that usually swings back, which is why our numbers flag him as due. His three-goal night against Winnipeg on Oct. 30 accounts for most of his goals in the last ten games.

He also draws hard matchups (Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 90th percentile last season). He missed the Nov. 7 game day to day with an undisclosed injury, per Daily Faceoff and others, and returned with two assists in Columbus. Watch the shot totals; the goals tend to follow.
headline: Lundell's points haven't caught up to his play
